items.en: Fixed a failing API request being retried up to 21 times when streaming kept failing; the non-streaming fallback now shares the request's retry budget instead of getting a fresh set of retries

items.ko: Claude in Chrome: 연결된 브라우저를 컴퓨터 이름으로 구분하도록 개선
items.en: Improved Claude in Chrome: the native host now reports your computer's name, so connected browsers can be labeled by computer instead of "Browser 1" / "Browser 2"

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex에서 기본 모델 접근이 막히면 같은 등급 구모델로 전환하도록 개선
items.en: Improved Bedrock and Vertex AI sessions to switch to an older available model of the same tier, instead of failing, when an admin removes access to the default model; session titles and summaries now fall back with it

items.ko: 플러그인 마켓플레이스가 git 주소 거부 사유를 정확히 알리도록 개선
items.en: Improved plugin marketplace errors to name why a git address is refused instead of citing enterprise policy

items.ko: 플러그인·마켓플레이스·현재 저장소 원격의 git URL 검증 강화
items.en: Improved validation of git URLs for plugins, marketplaces and the current repository's remote

items.ko: Artifact 결과가 작성·편집과 같은 단계에서 게시를 제안하도록 개선
items.en: Improved Artifact tool results: they now suggest publishing in the same step as writing or editing the page, which can save a round trip

items.ko: Remote Control `/btw` 질문이 진행 중인 턴까지 보도록 개선
items.en: Improved Remote Control: a `/btw` side question asked of a session hosted by an app such as Claude Desktop now sees the turn in progress, not only the last finished one

items.ko: BMP·HEIC·HEIF·AVIF·TIFF 이미지도 Claude 앱에서 미리보기되도록 개선
items.en: Improved pictures Claude sends as BMP, HEIC, HEIF, AVIF or TIFF files: the Claude apps now show a preview where Claude Code can convert them

items.ko: subagent가 보고를 넘긴 즉시 종료되도록 개선
items.en: Improved subagents in auto mode: a subagent's run now ends as soon as it hands its report back to its caller, instead of taking extra turns that reach no one

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex 시작 시 모델 검사 결과를 하루까지 재사용하도록 개선
items.en: Improved Bedrock and Vertex start-up model checks: models your account cannot use are now remembered for up to a day instead of being re-checked on every launch

items.ko: 아티팩트 게시 결과의 토큰 사용량을 줄이도록 개선
items.en: Improved Artifact tool publish results to use fewer tokens: the note on updating an artifact is shorter, and where to find your artifacts is no longer repeated after every publish

items.ko: 논스트리밍 폴백 중 SDK에 30초마다 `ping` 이벤트를 보내도록 개선
items.en: Improved SDK liveness during a non-streaming fallback request: with partial messages on, a `ping` stream event is now sent every 30 seconds on the Anthropic API, Claude Platform on AWS and gateways

items.ko: `/resume`·`claude --resume`이 백그라운드 세션도 열도록 개선
items.en: Improved `/resume` and `claude --resume` on a session that is running in the background: they now open that session instead of refusing, and a prompt given with `claude --resume <id> "prompt"` is sent to it as its next turn

items.ko: 거부 규칙·MCP 도구가 많을 때의 턴당 성능 개선
items.en: Improved per-turn performance when many permission deny rules and MCP tools are configured

items.ko: 긴 세션에서 ctrl+o 트랜스크립트를 닫을 때의 반응성 개선
items.en: Improved responsiveness when leaving the ctrl+o transcript view in long sessions when fullscreen rendering is off

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·Mantle 시작 검사가 일반 요청과 같은 헤더를 보내도록 개선
items.en: Improved Bedrock, Vertex and Mantle start-up model checks to send the same User-Agent, x-app and session ID headers as regular requests

items.ko: 도구가 `_meta`로 `alwaysLoad`를 false로 두면 서버 설정과 무관하게 지연 로드로 변경
items.en: Changed MCP tools so a tool that sets its own `_meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad']` to false stays deferred when its `--mcp-config`, Agent SDK or plugin server is set to `alwaysLoad`

items.ko: 백그라운드 Bash·PowerShell 명령이 기본 30분 뒤 중단되도록 변경
items.en: Changed background Bash and PowerShell commands to stop after a time limit (their `timeout` with `run_in_background`, default 30 min, max 2 h); Claude is notified when one is stopped

items.ko: `disableWorkflows`가 켜져 있어도 Code Review·`/ultrareview`가 실행되도록 변경
items.en: Changed Code Review's pull request reviews and `/ultrareview` to run when `disableWorkflows` is on, unless the machine running the review has it set by its own administrator (MDM or the managed-settings file)

items.ko: 커스텀 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 세션도 1M 컨텍스트 창을 쓰도록 변경
items.en: Changed sessions behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to use the 1M context window of models that have one (Opus 4.7+, Sonnet 5+, Fable); run `/autocompact 200k` if your gateway stops at 200K

items.ko: 조직 정책 로드 전까지 WebFetch를 보류하도록 변경 (Team·Enterprise 등)
items.en: Changed Team and Enterprise sessions, and sessions whose sign-in plan Claude Code can't determine, to withhold WebFetch until the organization policy loads if it couldn't be loaded at startup

items.ko: 백그라운드·도구 시작 세션에서는 Auto-memory를 켤 수 없도록 변경
items.en: Changed /memory so that Auto-memory can no longer be turned on from a background session or from a session one of Claude Code's own tools started; turning it off there still works

items.ko: auto 모드 기본 설정 제안을 서드파티 공급자·텔레메트리 해제에서도 표시하도록 변경
items.en: Changed the one-time offer to make auto mode your default permission mode to also show on third-party providers and with telemetry off, when your user settings default to another mode

items.ko: 권한 모드 미설정 시 `claude -p`·Python SDK 세션도 auto 모드로 시작하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `claude -p` and Python Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, like interactive sessions; `--permission-mode` still overrides it

items.ko: 기본 포트가 아닐 때 SigV4 서명 Host 헤더에 포트를 포함하도록 변경
items.en: Changed Bedrock, Mantle and Claude Platform on AWS requests to a base URL with a non-default port to include the port in the SigV4-signed Host header

items.ko: 클라우드 세션에서 MCP 서버 이름 `widgets`를 예약어로 변경 (이름 변경 필요)
items.en: Changed the MCP server name `widgets` to be reserved in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners: your own server under it, or a close spelling such as `widgets_`, no longer loads, so rename it

items.ko: `/ultrareview` 업로드에서 심볼릭 ref를 제외하도록 변경 (해당 브랜치는 거부)
items.en: Changed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux to leave symbolic refs out when uploading a local checkout; a checkout whose current branch is a symbolic ref is now refused with an explanation

items.ko: Windows: 프로젝트·로컬 설정 `env`가 시스템 경로 변수를 설정하지 못하도록 변경
items.en: Windows: Changed project and local settings `env` to no longer set `ALLUSERSPROFILE`, `SystemDrive`, or the `CommonProgramFiles` variables; set them in user or managed settings instead

items.ko: `/tasks`가 내부 백그라운드 작업을 "System tasks" 한 줄로 묶도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/tasks` to fold background work Claude Code runs for itself under one "System tasks" row; press Enter on it to show those tasks

items.ko: `/ultrareview` 로컬 저장소 업로드에 git 2.31 이상을 요구하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux to require git 2.31 or newer to upload a local repository; checkouts made with `--separate-git-dir` are now refused instead of being uploaded with an older method

items.ko: git 2.31 이상에서 부분 클론을 작업 트리 스냅샷으로 보내도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux to send a partial clone as a working-tree snapshot on git 2.31 or newer, instead of falling back or refusing when git's version looked too old

items.ko: 구버전 git에서 파일이 빠진 부분 클론은 페치 대신 거부하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux to refuse, instead of fetching, a partial clone missing some of its working tree's files on older git versions; a clone made without `--filter` uploads

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·Mantle 시작 검사가 Claude Code로 식별되도록 변경
items.en: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Mantle start-up model checks to identify themselves as Claude Code, like other Claude Code requests

items.ko: `claude mcp get`이 플러그인 stdio 서버의 명령·인자·환경 값을 가리도록 변경
items.en: Changed `claude mcp get` to hide the command, arguments, and environment values of stdio MCP servers provided by plugins; variable names are still shown

items.ko: Remote Control 클라이언트에서 `/claude-api`를 실행할 수 없도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/claude-api` so it can no longer be run from Remote Control clients

items.ko: `/config chrome=true`가 바로 켜지 않고 /config 패널로 안내하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/config chrome=true` to direct you to the /config panel instead of enabling Claude in Chrome by default; `/config chrome=false` still turns it off when it was on

items.ko: 프로젝트 설정이 관리자 샌드박스를 넓히거나 끄지 못하도록 변경
items.en: Changed sandbox settings so project settings cannot widen or turn off an admin-required sandbox, replace the proxy behind a managed deny list, extend a strict allowlist, or reopen managed read-denies

items.ko: VSCode: 창 새로고침으로 중단돼 응답이 오지 않을 때 안내 문구 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added a note under a restored tab's last message when a window reload interrupted it and no reply will follow

items.ko: VSCode: 플러그인 관리에 옵션 입력 폼 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added a plugin options form to Manage plugins: installing a plugin that has options asks for the unset ones, and a gear on its row changes them later

items.ko: VSCode: 문제 패널의 오류·경고를 언제든 읽는 진단 도구 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added an on-demand diagnostics tool so Claude in the panel can read the Problems panel's current errors and warnings at any time, not only right after it edits a file

items.ko: VSCode: 슬래시 명령 입력 후 Enter가 엉뚱한 항목을 실행하던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter after typing a slash command running an unrelated menu item picked by fuzzy match, or doing nothing

items.ko: VSCode: 열려 있는 에이전트 트랜스크립트가 새 메시지를 놓치던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed an open agent transcript losing the agent's newer messages during a long session

items.ko: VSCode: 태그를 인용한 메시지의 나머지 텍스트가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message that quotes a Claude Code or IDE tag losing the rest of its text in the chat

items.ko: VSCode: 작업 중 보낸 메시지가 세션 재개 후 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message sent while Claude was working disappearing from the conversation after the session was reopened

items.ko: VSCode: 계정 전환 후 Web 탭에 이전 계정 세션이 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list's Web tab showing the previous account's sessions after an account switch

items.ko: VSCode: 복원된 탭이 중단된 턴을 다시 실행하던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed restored tabs re-running an interrupted turn when VS Code was started with `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` set, even with Continue After Reload off

items.ko: VSCode: Escape가 메뉴를 닫지 않고 실행 중인 턴을 멈추던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping the running turn instead of closing the command menu after clicking one of its rows

items.ko: VSCode: 지난 대화 열기가 진행 중인 대화를 저장본으로 바꾸던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed opening Past conversations replacing a live conversation with its saved copy

items.ko: VSCode: 확장 재시작 후 탭이 빈 화면으로 남던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a Claude tab reloaded after an extension restart staying blank instead of saying how to recover

items.ko: VSCode: 다른 곳에서 열린 대화를 경고 없이 중복으로 열던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed opening a conversation that is already open in another window or app starting a second copy of it without warning; it now asks first

items.ko: VSCode: 창 새로고침 후 훅의 차단 사유가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a hook's reason for blocking or stopping a prompt disappearing after a window reload

items.ko: VSCode: 재개할 수 없는 대화에서 탭이 멈춰 있던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed tabs stuck on a conversation that can't be resumed: the error now says so and offers to start a new conversation

items.ko: VSCode: 자동 저장이 응답하지 않을 때 파일 도구가 10분간 멈추던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed every file Read, Write and Edit stalling for ten minutes and then being skipped when the editor stops responding to the extension's automatic save before the tool runs

items.ko: VSCode: 에이전트 맵이 서브에이전트 모델을 잘못 표시하던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the agent map labeling a sub-agent with the session's model instead of the model it actually ran on (e.g. under `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` or an agent's own `model`)

items.ko: VSCode: 플러그인 관리에서 삭제가 잘못된 설치를 지우던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed uninstalling a plugin from the Manage plugins dialog, which removed the wrong installation or failed for a plugin installed for the project

items.ko: VSCode: 로그인 방식을 다시 골라도 인증 코드 단계에 머물던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-in staying on the authorization-code step after going back and choosing the same sign-in method again

items.ko: VSCode: 긴 세션에서 오래된 줄을 정리할 때 채팅 패널이 멈추던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel stalling when a long session trims its oldest rows

items.ko: VSCode: 에이전트를 많이 띄우면 대화가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the conversation disappearing from a session when many agents run

items.ko: VSCode: 세션 이름을 바꿔도 편집기 탭 이름이 그대로던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the editor tab keeping an old name after a session was renamed with /rename, by a SessionStart hook, or on claude.ai

items.ko: VSCode: 에이전트 맵 트랜스크립트에 보낸 메시지가 빠지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the agent map's transcript view leaving out messages sent to a running agent

items.ko: VSCode: 플러그인 작업 실패 시 설명과 해결 방법을 팝업으로 안내
items.en: [VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed plugin action now opens a popup that explains it and, where there is one, offers the fix

items.ko: VSCode: 프로젝트 설정이 켠 플러그인·마켓플레이스 해제 전 확인하도록 변경
items.en: [VSCode] Changed the Manage plugins dialog to ask before removing a marketplace or turning off a plugin that your project's shared `.claude/settings.json` turns on

items.ko: 클라우드: 루틴 Run now 실패 시 내부 오류 문구가 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed Run now on a routine showing internal error text when the run is refused before it starts; it now shows the same explanation as the routine's failure notification

items.ko: 클라우드: `MCP_DISCOVERY_CACHE=1`이 커넥터 도구 목록만 재사용하도록 변경
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Changed `MCP_DISCOVERY_CACHE=1`, when set in your cloud environment's variables rather than a settings file, to reuse your connectors' tool lists after a session restart; other MCP servers are no longer cached and connect at startup

items.ko: Claude Tag: Cowork를 가진 Enterprise Chat 좌석에서도 Claude와 DM 가능
items.en: [Claude Tag] Added direct messages with Claude for members on an Enterprise plan Standard or Usage-Based Chat seat who also have Cowork; a seat that includes Claude Code is no longer required

items.ko: Claude Tag: 조직이 쓸 수 없는 모델이 기본 모델 설정에 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Default model setting in admin settings and a channel's Configure page offering models your organization can't use, which made saves or new sessions fail

items.ko: Claude Tag: 메시지를 수정하면 폴백 모델 안내가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the note under Claude's Slack messages saying it answered on a fallback model, and why, disappearing when Claude later edited that message

items.ko: Code Review: 저장소 추가 대화의 조직 목록이 일부만 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed the organization menu in Code Review's "Add a repository" dialog showing only a few of your GitHub organizations; it now loads more as you scroll

items.ko: Code Review: REVIEW.md가 적용되지 않은 이유를 체크 런에 표시
items.en: [Code Review] Improved the Code Review check run to say when your repository's REVIEW.md wasn't applied, for example on a very large pull request or when REVIEW.md is a symbolic link

items.ko: Sonnet 5.5(`claude-sonnet-5-5`) 추가 — Anthropic API 기본 Sonnet 모델
items.en: Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $2/$10 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads

items.ko: auto 모드 작업 디렉터리 밖 읽기 확인에 이번만 허용 선택지 추가
items.en: Added a "Yes, but ask again next time" answer to auto mode's prompt before a read outside the working directories, so you can allow that one read and still be asked about later ones

items.ko: `/usage`·상태 표시줄의 게이트웨이 지출 한도에 금액 표시 추가
items.en: Added dollar amounts to the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line (for example "$271.40 / $500.00 spent this month") when the gateway runs this version or later; the status line's `rate_limits.spend_limit` also gains `used_usd`, `limit_usd` and `period`

items.ko: `/effort` 슬라이더 키를 재바인딩하는 `effortSlider` 액션 추가
items.en: Added `effortSlider:decreaseEffort`, `increaseEffort` and `toggleUltracode` keybinding actions, so the `/effort` slider's arrow and Tab keys can be rebound in `keybindings.json`

items.ko: `/rate-limit-options` 를 `/help` 와 명령 메뉴에 노출
items.en: Added `/rate-limit-options` to `/help` and the command menu for claude.ai subscribers, so the usage-limit notices that mention it point to a command you can find

items.ko: `/mcp reconnect all` 추가 — 실패한 MCP 서버 일괄 재연결
items.en: Added `/mcp reconnect all` in the interactive terminal to retry every MCP server that failed to connect or needs authentication at once

items.ko: 게이트웨이 관리 정책의 `availableModels` 오류 시 시작 경고 추가
items.en: Added Claude apps gateway startup warnings when a managed policy's `availableModels` is empty, or leaves out the model Claude Code starts on without setting `model` or `enforceAvailableModels`

items.ko: 게이트웨이 텔레메트리 전달에 Google Cloud OTLP 인증 추가
items.en: Added `auth: { google: {} }` for Claude apps gateway `telemetry.forward_to` destinations, so telemetry can be exported straight to Google Cloud's OTLP endpoint using the gateway's Google Cloud credentials

items.ko: 게이트웨이-IdP 간 인증서 클라이언트 인증(`private_key_jwt`) 추가
items.en: Added certificate client authentication (`private_key_jwt`) between the Claude apps gateway and its identity provider, for identity providers that issue certificate credentials instead of client secrets

items.ko: 응답 스트림 손상 시 원시 오류·`undefined` 가 노출되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a damaged response stream showing raw errors such as "JSON Parse error" or "undefined is not an object", or writing the word "undefined" into an answer, instead of being retried or reported as an interrupted response

items.ko: thinking 블록 직후 서버 오류가 재시도 없이 턴을 끝내던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed an overloaded or server error arriving right after a thinking block ending the turn with an error instead of being retried

items.ko: 압축 후에도 프롬프트 길이 초과 오류가 남던 문제 수정 — 한 번 더 압축
items.en: Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors that persisted after compacting: when the compacted request is still too long, Claude Code now compacts once more, keeping less of the recent conversation

items.ko: 폴백 없는 모델 사용 불가 시 안내 대신 빈 오류만 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a session whose model is unavailable, with no fallback model left, showing a bare "is currently unavailable" message (or "Something went wrong" in cloud sessions) instead of the model-unavailable notice and its Learn more link

items.ko: Agent SDK 세션이 잘못된 이미지 `source` 로 크래시하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Agent SDK sessions crashing when a user message contains an image with a malformed `source`, and failing on every later turn after a malformed document block; a malformed image is now replaced with an explanatory note

items.ko: 재개한 세션에서 연결 중인 MCP 서버의 도구 호출이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed MCP tool calls in a resumed session failing with "No such tool available" while their server was still connecting; the call now waits up to 10 seconds for the server

items.ko: `/usage` 등이 요금제 조회 실패 후 재요청을 반복하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed repeated calls to the plan-usage endpoint after it rate-limits or rejects your login: `/usage`, `/extra-usage` and IDE usage views now back off instead of re-asking

items.ko: 관리 설정이 MCP 를 제한할 때 `claude mcp add` 가 성공으로 보고하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude mcp add` reporting success when managed settings restrict MCP servers to plugins; it now refuses and says what to do, instead of saving a server that never loads

items.ko: `/plugin` 설정 화면의 불리언·숫자 옵션 입력과 ←/→ 동작 수정
items.en: Fixed the `/plugin` configure screen: boolean options are now a true/false choice instead of free text, number options refuse invalid input, and ←/→ change an options field instead of switching tabs

items.ko: `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` 가 검증 없이 호스트에 삽입되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` being interpolated into the Foundry endpoint host unvalidated; a value that is not a plain resource name is now refused

items.ko: 게이트웨이 뒤 Claude Desktop 에 1M 컨텍스트 선택지가 없던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude Desktop behind a Claude apps gateway offering no 1M context option: the gateway now marks each 1M-capable model for Desktop automatically

items.ko: 셸 모드에서 ↓ 가 숨은 작업 알약을 선택해 편집이 막히던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed ↓ in shell mode selecting a hidden background-tasks pill, which stopped Backspace and Ctrl+U from editing the prompt

items.ko: 플러그인이 많을 때 Windows 에서 Bash 도구가 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash tool failing on Windows with many plugins enabled: plugin `bin/` directories that don't exist are no longer added to PATH, and inherited entries aren't added twice

items.ko: `sparsePaths` 마켓플레이스가 구버전 git 에서 빈 클론이 되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `sparsePaths` plugin marketplaces cloning empty and replacing a working local copy on older git (before 2.39), which failed every refresh with "marketplace.json file is no longer present"

items.ko: 전체 화면에서 `[` 스크롤백 기록이 위쪽 터미널 출력을 지우던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed fullscreen rendering erasing the terminal output above the session when `[` in transcript mode writes the conversation to scrollback (macOS and Linux)

items.ko: 전체 화면에서 스트리밍이 끝나면 스크롤 위치가 튀던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed fullscreen scroll position jumping to the previous message or to the bottom when a reply finished streaming while scrolled up

items.ko: 좁은 터미널에서 대화상자 탭 라벨이 단어 중간에서 잘리던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed tab bars in dialogs such as `/config` and `/plugin` breaking the title and tab labels mid-word in a narrow terminal; a tab that doesn't fit now moves to the next line whole

items.ko: `/model` 목록 끝에서 남은 모델 수가 잘못 표시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the `/model` picker showing "+1 model" below the list after scrolling to the last model; the count now covers only the models below the visible rows

items.ko: `/keybindings` 가 동작 없는 푸터 액션 바인딩을 기록하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/keybindings` writing Backspace and Delete bindings for a footer action that does nothing into the generated `keybindings.json`

items.ko: 재바인딩한 `footer:close` 가 에이전트 행에서 x 를 입력하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a rebound agent panel close key (`footer:close`) typing "x" instead of itself on the row of the agent you're viewing

items.ko: vim 모드 `.` 가 빠른 입력·붙여넣기를 반복하지 못하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode `.` not repeating text typed very fast (for example over ssh or in tmux) or pasted without bracketed paste, and leaving the prompt in INSERT mode after repeating a change with nothing typed (such as `cw` then Esc)

items.ko: vim 모드에서 `dd`·`yy` 후 커서가 이미지 자리표시자에 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor on an image placeholder's opening bracket after `dd` on the last line or `yy` at the end of the prompt, where `r` or `x` would break or delete the image

items.ko: 포커스 복귀 직후 키 입력이 Remote Control 활성화 확인을 대신 답하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a key pressed the instant the terminal regained focus answering the Remote Control enable prompt before its short safety delay restarted

items.ko: 홈 디렉터리에서 실행 시 작업 공간 신뢰 대화상자가 다시 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the workspace trust dialog appearing a second time after switching renderers or updating when Claude Code was started in the home directory

items.ko: 외부에서 심링크된 규칙이 승인 프롬프트 없이 건너뛰어지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed rules symlinked into `.claude/rules` from outside the project being skipped without ever showing the external-imports approval prompt; a `.claude` directory symlinked from outside the project now asks for the same approval

items.ko: 관리 설정 하에서 플러그인이 자기 도구를 선승인하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugins from marketplaces, claude.ai and npm pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; only plugins from an official Anthropic source or a source that managed settings vouch for keep that pre-approval

items.ko: 첫 `claude plugin install` 실패 후 플러그인이 활성 상태로 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a failed first `claude plugin install` leaving the plugin enabled and recorded when a dependency's version range could not be met

items.ko: 디버그 로그가 실패한 훅의 stderr·상태 코드를 누락하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the debug log dropping a failed hook's stderr when the hook also wrote to stdout, and logging nothing for a failed hook with no output; failed hooks now also log their status code

items.ko: Elicitation 훅이 반환한 `block` 결정이 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `{"decision":"block"}` returned by Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks being ignored; it now declines the MCP elicitation, as exit code 2 does

items.ko: `SendMessage` 없이 시작된 세션에 메시지 전송을 안내하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sessions launched without the `SendMessage` tool (such as by Claude Desktop) still being told to message other sessions with it

items.ko: Remote Control 로 보낸 사진이 대기 메시지 편집 시 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a photo sent from the Claude app over Remote Control being lost when its queued message was pulled back into the terminal prompt to edit, and the cursor moving one character for a photo with no caption

items.ko: 사용량 한도 대기 중 입력하면 자동 재개 설정이 적용되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed typing a message during an automatic usage-limit wait taking the wait out of the "Continue automatically at usage limit" setting's control when that turn hit the limit again

items.ko: 최상위 Max 사용자에게 `/upgrade` 를 권하던 사용량 경고 수정
items.en: Fixed usage-limit warnings suggesting `/upgrade` to users already on the highest Max plan; the warnings and `/upgrade` itself now point at `/usage-credits` when it is available

items.ko: Explore 서브에이전트가 미인식 모델 세션에서 Opus 로 바뀌던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the Explore subagent switching to Opus on the Claude API when the session runs a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as a custom model behind a proxy; Explore now inherits that model

items.ko: `/loop` 자율 모드의 상태 업데이트가 표시되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/loop` status updates in self-paced mode often not being shown because Claude wrote them only in its reasoning; Claude now writes each update, and the outcome when the loop stops, as visible text

items.ko: 데스크톱 앱이 만든 worktree 에서 `/ultrareview` 업로드가 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` failing to upload the working tree when started from a git worktree that the Claude desktop app created on macOS or Linux

items.ko: Linux 샌드박스 Bash 가 읽기 거부 디렉터리 탓에 시작 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing to start on Linux when the working directory is write-denied and contains a read-denied directory

items.ko: 아티팩트 DB 쓰기 결과의 공개 범위 오안내 수정, `as_level` 에 view 추가
items.en: Fixed artifact database write results telling Claude that every viewer sees a write to a viewer's private `data/users/` subtree, and added a "view" level to `as_level`

items.ko: 그룹이 많은 로그인에 게이트웨이가 431 을 반환하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway answering `431 Request Header Fields Too Large` to every request from a sign-in whose identity provider lists many groups; it now accepts request headers up to 256 KiB

items.ko: 사용량 한도 상태와 카운트다운을 프롬프트 아래 한 블록으로 정리
items.en: Improved the usage-limit wait: the limit's state and the countdown with the usage-credits option now show as one block under the prompt, and limit messages no longer repeat the countdown

items.ko: Chrome 도구 접두어 누락 오류가 호출할 도구 이름을 알려주도록 개선
items.en: Improved the "No such tool available" error for Claude in Chrome tools called without their prefix: it now names the tool to call

items.ko: Monitor 이벤트 행이 설명 대신 실제 출력을 보여주도록 개선
items.en: Improved Monitor event rows to show what each event printed instead of repeating the description, and stopped repeating an unchanged "Waiting for N … to finish" line after every event

items.ko: Workflow 스크립트 훅의 비동기 오류에 대한 샌드박스 강화
items.en: Improved Workflow tool sandbox hardening for errors thrown by async script hooks

items.ko: 설정 스키마를 실제 사용하는 부분만 구성해 시작 시간·메모리 개선
items.en: Improved startup time and memory use by building only the parts of the settings schema that your settings files actually use

items.ko: `/claude-api` `hillclimb` 의 낭비 라운드 제거, 추가 페이지는 단일 로컬 파일로
items.en: Improved `/claude-api`: `hillclimb` no longer spends rounds on prompt rewordings too small for the eval to measure, and an extra page you ask for beside `report.html` is built as one local file that loads nothing from the network

items.ko: `/tasks`·`/copy`·`/hooks` 목록의 상세 정보 정렬 개선
items.en: Improved lists such as `/tasks`, `/copy` and `/hooks`: the details after each name now line up in one column when they fit, and otherwise sit at the right edge

items.ko: `claude plugin marketplace add` 가 동명 마켓플레이스 교체를 알리도록 개선
items.en: Improved `claude plugin marketplace add` to say when it replaces a marketplace already added under the same name from a different source, and how to undo it

items.ko: 관리 설정의 로그인 강제와 API 키가 충돌할 때 시작 거부 안내 개선
items.en: Improved the startup refusal when managed settings require a sign-in (`forceLoginMethod` or `forceLoginOrgUUID`) and an API key, token or `apiKeyHelper` is configured: it now names the credential in use, where it is set, and how to remove it

items.ko: 메모리 로드 시 위장 마크업·보이지 않는 문자를 무력화하도록 강화
items.en: Improved auto-memory loading: invisible characters and tags that imitate Claude Code's own markup are neutralized in `MEMORY.md` and recalled memory notes before they reach Claude

items.ko: `claude remote-control` 이 미신뢰 폴더에서 종료 대신 신뢰를 묻도록 개선
items.en: Improved `claude remote-control`: in a folder you haven't trusted yet, it now asks for workspace trust on the terminal instead of exiting

items.ko: 아티팩트 페이지가 설계 계획을 답변 대신 페이지에 쓰도록 개선
items.en: Improved artifact pages: Claude writes its design plan into the page instead of the reply, and uses the name you already gave something as the page title

items.ko: 아티팩트 도구가 잘못된 링크·ID 입력 시 중단 대신 되묻도록 개선
items.en: Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude is given a claude.ai chat or project link, an artifact from a chat, or an artifact id on its own, it asks for the right link or the content instead of stopping

items.ko: 대화형 터미널·VS Code 세션의 기본 권한 모드가 auto 로 변경
items.en: Changed interactive terminal and VS Code sessions to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, on every plan and provider; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it

items.ko: Ultracode 가 `/effort` 의 별도 토글로 변경 — xhigh 강제 없음
items.en: Changed Ultracode into its own toggle in `/effort` (Tab, or `/effort ultracode [on|off]`): it no longer forces xhigh effort and stays on at any effort level

items.ko: 연결 끊김 재시도가 요청 전체의 재시도 예산을 공유하도록 변경
items.en: Changed retries after a dropped connection mid-response to share one budget with the rest of the request's retries, so a failing request gives up sooner

items.ko: Sonnet 안전장치 차단 안내가 사유와 편집·재시도를 안내하도록 변경
items.en: Changed the notice shown when a Sonnet model's safeguards flag a message to explain why it happened and to offer editing and retrying

items.ko: Opus 고정 세션의 안전 전환 대상 모델을 API 가 고르도록 변경
items.en: Changed safety-related model switches in sessions that pin an Opus model with `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` or `modelOverrides`: on the Anthropic API, the API now picks the model to switch to for each kind of flag, not the pinned model

items.ko: 비대화형 첫 턴이 지정된 MCP 서버를 최대 2초 기다리도록 변경
items.en: Changed the non-interactive first turn to still wait up to 2s for connecting MCP servers named by `--allowedTools` or an `mcp_tool` hook, even when `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` is `0`

items.ko: `/recap` 이 스레드·루틴·웹훅 경유 호출을 거절하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/recap` to decline with a short notice when it arrives relayed from a chat thread (your own included) or from a routine or webhook; typed in the terminal, the Claude apps, Remote Control, `-p` or an SDK host, it runs as before

items.ko: `/artifacts` 필터 탭을 제목 옆 한 단어 라벨로 변경
items.en: Changed `/artifacts` to show its filter tabs beside the title with one-word labels (All, Mine, Shared), using the same tab bar as `/config` and `/plugin`

items.ko: 아티팩트 게시가 네트워크 공유 경로의 파일을 거부하도록 변경
items.en: Changed artifact publishing to refuse a file on a network share (a `\\host\share` path or a `/net` automount) unless it is on a mapped network drive added with `--add-dir`

items.ko: [VSCode] 프롬프트·응답 위 시각 표시 설정 추가 (기본 꺼짐)
items.en: [VSCode] Added an optional time above each prompt and response, with a date line where the day changes (Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps setting, off by default)

items.ko: [VSCode] 플러그인 관리 목록에 로드 오류와 처리 팝업 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added plugin load errors and notes to the Manage plugins rows, with a popup to disable, uninstall or copy the error

items.ko: [VSCode] Effort 슬라이더 아래 Ultracode 온/오프 스위치 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added an Ultracode on/off switch under the Effort slider, replacing the slider's Ultracode stop; the model pill shows "· Ultracode" at any effort level

items.ko: [VSCode] 메모리 파일 저장 전에 Claude 가 재시작되던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Reload Claude from the Memory dialog restarting before an edited file was saved

items.ko: [VSCode] 다른 프로세스가 연 대화를 복원 탭이 그대로 열던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a restored tab opening a conversation another Claude process still has open; it now asks first

items.ko: [VSCode] 펼쳐 둔 Focus 뷰 섹션이 저절로 닫히던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view sections you expanded closing on their own while a sub-agent is working or when the section's first step is trimmed from view

items.ko: [VSCode] `/model` 입력 시 선택기 대신 사용법이 출력되던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed typing `/model` and Enter printing usage text into the chat instead of opening the model selector

items.ko: [VSCode] Vertex·Bedrock·Foundry 에서 `/feedback` 이 거부되던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/feedback` on Vertex, Bedrock and Foundry being refused after you pressed Send; the report is now saved on this computer, as the terminal does

items.ko: [VSCode] 창 재로드 후 로그인이 Python 확장을 오래 기다리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-in waiting up to a minute for the Python extension after a window reload

items.ko: [VSCode] Restart Extensions 후 응답이 없던 탭이 다시 열리도록 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude Code tabs that stopped responding after Restart Extensions: they now reopen on their conversation

items.ko: [VSCode] 발신자 없는 에이전트 메시지가 원시 XML 로 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message from another agent with no recorded sender showing as raw XML in the chat

items.ko: [VSCode] 재로드 후 다른 에이전트·세션 메시지가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed messages from other agents, sessions or channels disappearing after a reload

items.ko: [VSCode] 사용자 정의 `/mcp`·`/config` 명령이 확장 대화상자에 가려지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/mcp`, `/config` or `/settings` command being shadowed by the extension's dialog

items.ko: [VSCode] 턴이 없을 때 Escape 가 백그라운드 에이전트를 모두 멈추던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping every background agent when no turn was running

items.ko: [VSCode] 플러그인 설치 링크가 동명 마켓플레이스를 교체하던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed plugin install links replacing a marketplace you already have that uses the same name

items.ko: [VSCode] 대용량 파일 첨부 시 압축 후 프롬프트 길이 초과 오류 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors after compaction when a large text file is attached to a message

items.ko: [VSCode] 비ASCII·공백·괄호가 든 경로의 파일 링크가 안 열리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed chat links to files with non-ASCII characters, spaces or brackets in their path not opening

items.ko: [VSCode] `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 이 절대 경로일 때만 적용되도록 변경
items.en: [VSCode] Changed `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` in the `claudeCode.environmentVariables` setting to apply only when it is an absolute path, and passed it to terminals that continue the chat

items.ko: [Cloud sessions] 오프라인일 때 루틴 편집 컨트롤이 로딩 중이라 하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed a routine's Edit and Duplicate controls saying the routine was still loading while you were offline; they now tell you you're offline

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 스레드·채널·DM 에 모델 계열(최신 Opus 등) 선택 추가
items.en: [Claude Tag] Added model family choices such as "Opus (latest)" for a thread, a channel default or your DM, so the choice follows the newest model in that family

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 지출 예측 차트에 조직 한도 대비 사용량 추가
items.en: [Claude Tag] Added the spend that counts toward your organization-wide limit to the analytics spend projection chart, with how much of the limit is used

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 밑줄 든 GHE 호스트에서 저장소·PR 버튼이 빠지던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card and link previews omitting the repository and Create PR button when a GitHub Enterprise host name contains an underscore

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 환경이 시작을 거부한 채널에서 침묵하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude staying silent in a channel whose environment declines to start it; it now posts one notice asking you to contact an admin, and retries when @-mentioned

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 미연결 사용자의 매 @멘션마다 로그인 안내를 게시하도록 변경
items.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude to post its private sign-in notice at every @mention from someone who hasn't connected their Claude account, instead of going quiet after the first

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 멤버 알림이 Enterprise Grid 전체 워크스페이스에 닿도록 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved "Notify members now" in admin settings: one press reaches every workspace your organization claimed in an Enterprise Grid, and more members in large workspaces

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 자체 호스팅 러너 대기 안내가 러너 상태를 밝히도록 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's wait notice on self-hosted environments with on-demand runners: it now says whether a runner is starting, a start will be retried, or no runner will start

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 채널 관리자 추가 실패 시 워크스페이스 연결 오류 안내 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the error shown when adding a channel manager fails because the channel's Slack workspace can't be confirmed as connected to your organization

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 채널 접근 목록에 자동 참여 패턴이 붙이는 항목과 출처 표시
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved a channel's access lists in admin settings to show the connectors, repositories and plugins an auto-join pattern attaches, and where each comes from

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 저장소 추가 시 GitHub 관리자 확인 실패하면 재로그인 안내
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved adding repositories as a channel manager: when your GitHub sign-in can't confirm you're a repository admin, the page asks you to sign in with GitHub

items.ko: [Code Review] 미제출 리뷰가 열려 있으면 결과를 게시하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review giving up without posting a finished review when an unsubmitted review under its GitHub App was open on the pull request; it now retries the post first

items.ko: LLM 게이트웨이용 `x-claude-code-prompt-id` 힌트 헤더 추가 (옵트인)
items.en: Added `x-claude-code-prompt-id` to the gateway hint headers so LLM gateways can group the requests that serve one user prompt; opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`

items.ko: `availableModelsMatch` 관리 설정 추가 — `exact` 는 명시된 버전만 허용
items.en: Added `availableModelsMatch` managed setting: with `"exact"`, an `availableModels` entry allows only the model version it names, so new releases stay blocked until listed

items.ko: 특정 모델을 차단하는 `deniedModels` 관리 설정 추가
items.en: Added `deniedModels` managed setting to block specific models, even when `availableModels` allows them

items.ko: `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1` 시 MCP·WebFetch·WebSearch 출력 span 기록 추가
items.en: Added MCP tool, WebFetch and WebSearch outputs to the `tool.output` OpenTelemetry span event when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1`

items.ko: 구버전 모델용 프롬프트 패턴을 점검하는 `/doctor prompt-audit` 추가
items.en: Added `/doctor prompt-audit` (also `/checkup prompt-audit`) to audit your CLAUDE.md files, skills, agents and commands for prompting patterns written for older models

items.ko: 전체화면에서 다른 세션의 잘린 메시지 클릭 펼치기 추가
items.en: Added click-to-expand for truncated messages from your other sessions in fullscreen mode

items.ko: stream-json `plugin_errors` 에 로드 실패 디렉터리 `path` 추가
items.en: Added `path` to `--plugin-dir` load-failure entries in the stream-json `system/init` `plugin_errors`, naming the directory that did not load

items.ko: Claude apps 게이트웨이에 부하 테스트용 `load_test_mode` 블록 추가
items.en: Added an opt-in `load_test_mode` block to the Claude apps gateway config: requests are built and signed but not sent upstream, and clients get a canned reply, so a deployment can be load tested

items.ko: Claude apps 게이트웨이에 Bedrock Mantle 용 `mantle` 프로바이더 추가
items.en: Added a `mantle` upstream provider to the Claude apps gateway for Amazon Bedrock's Mantle endpoint

items.ko: SDK 세션의 지연 도구 호출·결과 유실과 `result.usage` 오류 수정
items.en: Fixed SDK sessions losing a deferred tool call or finished tool result when a turn ended early, a held approval prompt after a worker restart, and a non-streaming fallback's `result.usage`

items.ko: 백그라운드로 넘어간 도구 호출의 MCP 진행 알림 유실 수정
items.en: Fixed MCP progress notifications being discarded once a long-running tool call moved to the background; the background task now shows the latest progress

items.ko: 시작 중이던 stdio MCP 서버가 세션 종료 후에도 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed stdio MCP servers being left running when the session ended while they were still starting

items.ko: 원격 MCP 서버의 일시적 404 후 세션 내내 사용 불가였던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a brief HTTP 404 from a stateless remote MCP server (for example a proxy mid-redeploy) leaving that server unusable for the rest of the session while still shown as connected

items.ko: URL 이 유효하지 않은 MCP 서버의 불명확한 로그인 실패 수정
items.en: Fixed MCP sign-in for a server with no valid URL failing with an opaque SDK error; `/mcp` no longer offers Authenticate for such servers

items.ko: 텔레메트리 비활성 시 `/usage` 에 주간 Fable 한도가 없던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the weekly Fable limit not appearing in `/usage` and the VS Code usage meters when telemetry is disabled

items.ko: 접미사 붙은 id 의 `[1m]` 모델이 `/model` 에서 잘못 허용되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/model` accepting Sonnet 4.6 or Sonnet 5 with `[1m]` when the id carried a date or `-v1:0` suffix, in the cases where the plain id was refused

items.ko: `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL` 지정 시 고정 Haiku 버전·가격 표시 수정
items.en: Fixed `/model` picker showing a hardcoded Haiku version and price when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL` pins a different model

items.ko: 모델 폴백 중 시작된 동적 워크플로가 전 에이전트를 폴백 모델로 돌린 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed dynamic workflows started during a model fallback running every agent on the fallback model instead of retrying the configured model

items.ko: Haiku 가 주 모델일 때 `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` 가 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` having no effect when Haiku is the session's main model

items.ko: `claude plugin validate` 가 설치 불가 이름을 통과시키던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` saying Claude Code accepts a plugin or marketplace name it cannot install; such names in `marketplace.json` now fail validation

items.ko: `claude plugin validate` 가 플러그인 밖 경로를 통과시키던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing plugins whose `outputStyles`, `themes`, `monitors`, or `lspServers` paths are missing or point outside the plugin directory

items.ko: `claude plugin details` 가 MCP 서버를 0개로 표시하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude plugin details` showing 0 MCP servers for plugins that declare their servers in `plugin.json`

items.ko: `claude plugin marketplace remove` 가 삭제한 플러그인을 알리지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude plugin marketplace remove` not saying which installed plugins it uninstalled with the marketplace; it now lists them

items.ko: 대소문자만 다른 id 의 다른 플러그인이 삭제되던 `uninstall` 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude plugin uninstall` removing the other of two installed plugins whose ids differ only in case, with its options and secrets, when the one named had no `enabledPlugins` entry at that scope

items.ko: 버전 미선언 플러그인이 설치본 대신 최신 커밋으로 복원되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugins that declare no version being silently restored at their source's newest commit, not the installed one, when their cached files were missing

items.ko: 홈·설정 디렉터리 이동 후 플러그인이 cache-miss 로 로드 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed user-installed plugins and marketplaces failing to load with "cache-miss" after the home or config directory was moved, for example in bind-mounted devcontainers

items.ko: 잘못된 플러그인 id 기록 때문에 `installed_plugins.json` 이 비던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `installed_plugins.json` showing no plugins when it holds a record under an invalid plugin id; such a file loads again

items.ko: 읽을 수 없는 기록 때문에 `installed_plugins.json` 이 덮어써지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `installed_plugins.json` being rewritten, losing records, when it holds a record this version cannot read; `claude plugin` commands now name the record and say how to recover

items.ko: 스크린 리더 모드에서 권한 대화상자가 인용 명령을 본문처럼 읽던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed permission dialogs in screen-reader mode reading quoted commands and paths as if they were the dialog's own text

items.ko: `/context` 가 MCP 서버 지침을 집계하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/context` not counting MCP server instructions: they now appear as their own row and count toward the total

items.ko: Warp 터미널에서 마크다운 링크가 일반 텍스트로 표시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed markdown links in the Warp terminal rendering as plain text instead of clickable hyperlinks

items.ko: 설정 파일 쓰기 실패에도 `claude mcp add`·`remove` 가 성공을 알린 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude mcp add`, `add-json`, and `remove` reporting success when the user or local config file could not be written, for example inside a sandbox

items.ko: 클라우드 세션 답변의 첫 부분이 스트리밍되지 않고 늦게 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the first words of a reply in a cloud session sometimes appearing late instead of streaming as Claude writes them

items.ko: 내장 키바인딩 안내의 chord 시간 제한·`cmd` 별칭 설명 오류 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude's built-in keybindings guide saying chords time out after 1 second instead of 3, and calling `cmd` an alias of `meta`, which could produce `cmd+` shortcuts most terminals never send

items.ko: `keybindings.json` 의 잘못된 수정자 표기가 조용히 통과되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `keybindings.json` silently accepting a misspelled modifier such as `ctl+k`; it now warns in the debug log and suggests the fix

items.ko: `footer:openSelected` 재바인딩 후에도 남던 푸터 힌트 문구 수정
items.en: Fixed footer hints still saying "Enter to view" after `footer:openSelected` was rebound or unbound in `keybindings.json`

items.ko: 빠르게 연속 입력된 키가 낡은 상태로 처리되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed keys typed quickly together (type-ahead, key repeat, bursts over ssh or tmux) sometimes being handled against stale state

items.ko: `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` 로 CA 인증서 전달 시 worktree 체크아웃 인증 실패 수정
items.en: Fixed worktree checkouts failing certificate verification (for example on Git LFS downloads) when the CA certificate is passed to git as `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` environment pairs

items.ko: 샌드박스 `git` 이 프록시 로그인을 자격증명 헬퍼에 저장하려던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sandboxed `git` asking credential helpers to store the sandbox proxy's login, which printed "failed to store"

items.ko: 값 하나가 잘못되면 관리 `sandbox` 설정 전체가 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed managed `sandbox` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the invalid value now fails closed and the rest of the block still applies

items.ko: 저장소 하위 디렉터리에서 Claude 의 자동 메모 편집이 차단되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude's edits to its own auto-memory notes being blocked as sensitive-file writes when Claude Code was started in a subdirectory of a git repository

items.ko: 텔레메트리 비활성 시 유료 플랜에서 Remote Control 이 막히던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Remote Control being unavailable on paid plans when telemetry is turned off with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK`

items.ko: 좁은 터미널에서 `/remote-control` QR 안내가 단어 중간에 잘리던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the `/remote-control` menu cutting its QR-code hint mid-word in narrow terminals

items.ko: vim 모드 `.` 이 Shift+Enter 개행을 빠뜨리던 문제 등 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode `.` dropping a Shift+Enter newline, leaving the cursor inside an accented letter, and repeating an older change after `3J` or Visual-mode `J` on the last line

items.ko: vim 모드 커서 위치 수정 — 긴 프롬프트 복원, `V` 후 `p`
items.en: Fixed vim mode cursor placement: recalling a prompt over 10,000 characters in normal mode no longer leaves the cursor past the end, and `V` then `p` now lands on the first non-blank

items.ko: vim 모드 `J` 의 줄 합치기 간격이 Vim 과 다르던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode `J` joining lines with different spacing than Vim (such as a space before `)` or after a tab), and `3J` or Visual-mode `J` on the last line not moving the cursor as Vim does

items.ko: PowerShell 도구에서 `cmd /c rd`·`del` 로 드라이브 루트·홈이 삭제되던 문제 수정
items.en: Windows: Fixed the PowerShell tool letting `cmd /c rd`, `rmdir`, `del` or `erase` delete drive roots, the home folder and other folders that `Remove-Item` refuses

items.ko: `/mcp` 도구 목록 개선 — 표시 개수·스크롤·조직 차단 아이콘
items.en: Improved the `/mcp` tool list: it shows more tools at once, scrolls with the page keys and mouse, and marks tools your organization blocked with a warning icon

items.ko: MCP 도구 이미지를 파일로도 저장해 Bash·Read 로 열도록 개선
items.en: Improved MCP tool results: images returned by MCP tools are now also saved to a file, so Bash, Read and other tools can open them

items.ko: `/tasks` 개선 — 상태 아이콘·전체 정보 표시, 페이징·마우스 지원
items.en: Improved `/tasks`: rows show a status icon, the name and whole facts, the title and key hints stay on screen with many tasks, and the list gains paging keys, the mouse wheel and clicks

items.ko: `/help`·`/hooks`·`/plugin` 등 목록에 페이지 키·마우스 지원 추가
items.en: Improved lists in `/help`, `/hooks`, `/copy`, `/chrome`, `/memory`, `/ide`, `/release-notes`, `/rewind`, `/diff`, `/remote-env`, `/plugin` and other pickers with page keys, mouse wheel and clicks

items.ko: 검색 상자 옆 목록의 포인터를 흐리게 그리도록 개선
items.en: Improved lists beside a search box, such as `/skills` and `/artifacts`, to draw their pointer dim while the search box has the keys, so only one pointer is highlighted

items.ko: 압축 스피너 개선 — 타이머 시작 시점과 요약 토큰 수 표시
items.en: Improved the compaction spinner: its timer now starts when compaction begins and it counts the summary's tokens as they stream, replacing the percentage bar

items.ko: MCP 로그인 후 브라우저 페이지 개선 — 중앙 정렬·다크 모드
items.en: Improved the browser page shown after signing in to an MCP server: centered layout, dark mode, and new artwork

items.ko: 로드 실패한 플러그인의 스킬 호출 시 Skill 도구 응답 개선
items.en: Improved the Skill tool's reply when a skill belongs to a plugin that failed to load, so Claude tells you the plugin could not be loaded instead of calling the skill uninstalled

items.ko: `prompt-audit` 개선 — 낡은 경로·명령·상충 지침을 보고 앞에 배치
items.en: Improved `prompt-audit` on Claude Code configuration: stale paths, stale commands and contradicting instruction files now lead the report, and thinking keywords that Claude Code documents are kept

items.ko: 읽을 수 없는 `installed_plugins.json` 내용을 옆 파일로 보존하도록 개선
items.en: Improved recovery from an `installed_plugins.json` that cannot be read at all: its contents are kept in a file beside it before it is rebuilt, and `claude plugin list` names that file

items.ko: 아티팩트 정렬 조회가 한 페이지임과 나머지 읽는 법을 알리도록 개선
items.en: Improved artifact database reads: an ordered query that returns a full page now says it is one page and how to read the rest

items.ko: 첫 응답 지연 개선 — 패턴 컴파일을 응답 스트리밍 중 수행
items.en: Improved first-reply latency: a pattern-compile step that ran at the end of a session's first reply now runs while the reply streams in

items.ko: 미리 연결된 API 커넥션 재사용으로 첫 요청 지연 개선
items.en: Improved first-request latency by reusing the preconnected API connection

items.ko: `claude -p`·Remote 의 대화형 UI 미로드 등 시작 속도 개선
items.en: Improved startup: `claude -p` and Claude Code Remote no longer load the interactive UI, and the auto-mode classifier's rules and the Artifact tool load on first use instead of at launch

items.ko: 아티팩트 기능 확인 때문에 프롬프트가 최대 1.5초 대기하던 문제 개선
items.en: Improved startup for claude.ai accounts whose Artifact tool features aren't known yet, as on a first run: the prompt no longer waits up to 1.5 s to check them; the first message waits if needed

items.ko: 서드파티 공급자·텔레메트리 비활성 세션의 기본 권한 모드를 auto 로 변경
items.en: Changed interactive sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it

items.ko: `/ultrareview` 대화상자에 미커밋 변경 업로드 가능 안내 추가
items.en: Changed the `/ultrareview` launch dialog to say that reviewing a local branch may upload uncommitted changes to tracked files

items.ko: `/model` Opus 행·기본 모델 이름의 `(1M context)` 표기 제거
items.en: Changed the `/model` picker's Opus row and the Default model's name to drop "(1M context)" where Opus already has a 1M context window; the window is unchanged

items.ko: 프롬프트 제안이 20회 연속 미사용 후 덜 표시되도록 변경
items.en: Changed prompt suggestions in the terminal to appear less often after 20 in a row go unused; using one brings them back

items.ko: `--system-prompt` 와 `-file` 형태 동시 지정 허용 — 파일 텍스트 우선
items.en: Changed `--system-prompt` and `--append-system-prompt` to accept their text and `-file` forms together; the file's text comes first

items.ko: `Skill(...)` 거부 규칙이 Desktop 플러그인 스킬·별칭에도 적용되도록 변경
items.en: Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` deny rules to also block that skill when Claude Desktop delivers it as a plugin, and `Skill(skill:<name>)` denies to match the skill's alias and display name

items.ko: `/rewind`·`/diff` 목록이 공통 `select:*` 키바인딩을 쓰도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/rewind` and `/diff` lists to move on the same keybinding actions as every other list (`select:*`); `messageSelector:*`/`diff:*` rebinds still work

items.ko: `/workflows` 실행 목록 크기를 다른 목록과 같게 변경
items.en: Changed the `/workflows` run list to size itself like other lists: half the terminal inline, and it keeps its title on screen when the prompt shows below

items.ko: `claude plugin eval` 이 git 2.31 이상을 요구하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `claude plugin eval` to require git 2.31 or later when git is installed; a run on an older git is refused with a message naming the version

items.ko: 자동 설정된 아티팩트 감시가 활동 없으면 3.5시간 후 종료되도록 변경
items.en: Changed artifact watching: a watch that was armed automatically (not one you asked for) now ends after 3.5 hours with no activity; publishing or watching the artifact again re-arms it

items.ko: 자체 호스팅 러너: 생애주기 훅 git 이 LFS `pre-push` 훅을 건너뛰도록 변경
items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed lifecycle hooks' git to skip a repository's Git LFS `pre-push` hook, ignore a writable system `core.hooksPath`, and not sign commits without `--configure-git`

items.ko: 자체 호스팅 러너: `GIT_SSL_CAINFO`·`GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` 적용 범위 변경
items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `GIT_SSL_CAINFO` and `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` under Anthropic-managed git: the runner's own git always verifies Anthropic's git route, and warning lines say what applies where

items.ko: 2.1.282 의 `claude-ai` 이름 예약 되돌림 — 해당 스킬·명령 다시 로드
items.en: Reverted the 2.1.282 reservation of the `claude-ai` name: skills, commands, workflows and MCP servers' skills and prompts so named load again, and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` rules are ordinary prefix rules

items.ko: VSCode: auto·bypass 모드인데 표시기가 Default 로 남던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the permission mode indicator showing Default while the session kept running in auto or bypass mode after an automatic switch out of it failed; the switch is now retried until it lands

items.ko: VSCode: 웹에서 이어받은 세션이 작업 중 보낸 메시지를 버리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session teleported from the web dropping the messages sent while Claude was working

items.ko: VSCode: 빈 로컬 복사본 때문에 웹 세션이 목록에서 숨던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a Web session staying hidden from the session list, and an empty chat opening in its place, when an older version had saved an empty local copy of it

items.ko: VSCode: 재개한 세션이 턴 중간 메시지에서 턴을 쪼개던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a reopened session splitting a turn at a message Claude received mid-turn, such as an automatic continuation

items.ko: VSCode: 다시 로드한 세션이 되돌린 턴이나 압축 이전 행만 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a reloaded session showing a rewound-away turn, or only the rows before a compaction

items.ko: VSCode: 좁은 패널에서 에이전트 pill 아이콘이 치우쳐 그려지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the footer's agents pill drawing its icon off-center, with the status dot against the edge, in narrow panels

items.ko: VSCode: 줄바꿈으로 끝나는 붙여넣기 후 입력 텍스트가 어긋나던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat input showing its text slightly below the cursor and selection after pasting lines that end with a line break into a long prompt

items.ko: 실행 중 클라우드 세션에 읽기 권한만 있는 비공개 저장소 연결 개선
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved adding a repository to a running cloud session: a private repository your GitHub account can read but not push to now attaches for reading

items.ko: 클라우드 세션이 재시작 후 완료된 단계를 다시 수행하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions occasionally redoing an already-finished step, such as posting a duplicate comment or push, after recovering from a server-side restart

items.ko: 새 루틴 일정 기본값을 정시 몇 분 뒤로 변경 — 정시 지연 안내 추가
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Changed new routine schedules to default to a few minutes past the hour, with a note that routines set exactly on the hour can start several minutes late

items.ko: Claude Tag: Slack 검색 채널을 제한하는 관리자 설정 추가
items.en: [Claude Tag] Added a "Channels Claude can search" admin setting that limits Claude's Slack search to public channels it has been added to, set per organization, workspace or channel

items.ko: Claude Tag: 계정 연결 후 원래 스레드로 돌아가는 버튼 추가
items.en: [Claude Tag] Added a Back to Slack button on the page shown after connecting your Claude account, returning you to the thread you started from

items.ko: Claude Tag: 규칙으로 연결된 접근 번들의 커넥터·플러그인 미표시 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a channel's configure page listing no connectors or plugins when the channel gets its access bundle through an attach rule; rule-attached bundles are now shown

items.ko: Claude Tag: 선택 저장소가 많은 GitHub App 에서 저장소 검색 누락 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed access-bundle repository search missing repositories on GitHub App installs that are limited to a large list of selected repositories

items.ko: Claude Tag: 답변 중 새 메시지가 오면 같은 답변을 두 번 올리던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude occasionally posting the same reply twice when a new message interrupted it mid-reply

items.ko: Claude Tag: 채널 ID 가 바뀐 비공개 채널의 루틴 중단 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed channel routines that stopped running in older private channels whose Slack channel ID changed, for example after a Slack Connect share

items.ko: Claude Tag: 멤버 합류 확인이 늦으면 채널 대화가 모두 종료되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed conversations in a channel set to "Channel only" all ending when a non-guest member joined and Slack was slow to confirm their membership

items.ko: Code Review: PR 조회 실패 시 리뷰 요청이 침묵하던 문제 수정 — 1회 재시도
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed "@claude review" requests going silent when GitHub failed to return the pull request: the request is retried once, and a comment explains if it still fails

items.ko: Code Review: 시간 제한으로 중단된 리뷰의 과금 수정 — 미완료 표시·재시도
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed billing for a review that stopped at its time limit with nothing verified: it now shows as incomplete, isn't charged, and is retried once

items.ko: 넓은 터미널에서 본문 폭을 제한하는 `maxProseWidth` 설정 추가
items.en: Added a `maxProseWidth` setting that caps the width of Claude's prose in wide terminals while tables and code blocks keep the full width

items.ko: 무시되거나 텔레메트리를 끈 설정 변수를 시작 시·`/status`·`claude doctor`에 표시
items.en: Added a startup notice, and `/status` and `claude doctor` entries, listing telemetry variables in a project's settings files that were ignored or that turned telemetry off

items.ko: `claude --chrome` 허용 관리 설정 `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` 추가
items.en: Added the `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` managed setting to let `claude --chrome` run alongside an exclusive `managed-mcp.json`; the error shown when Chrome is blocked now names it

items.ko: 짧은 Postgres 장애 동안 `/readyz` 준비 상태를 유지하는 `store.readiness_grace_seconds` 추가
items.en: Added `store.readiness_grace_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway so `/readyz` can stay ready through a short Postgres outage such as a database failover

items.ko: 전체화면 `/feedback` 임시저장 목록에 마우스 오버 시 나타나는 스크롤바 추가
items.en: Added a scrollbar to the `/feedback` drafts list in fullscreen mode; it appears while the mouse is over the list

items.ko: API가 복호화 못 하는 웹 검색 결과가 있는 대화에서 모든 요청이 400으로 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed every request failing with a 400 error in conversations whose history holds web search results the API cannot decrypt (for example, from a turn answered through a third-party gateway)

items.ko: `--continue`·`--resume` 세션이 이전 메시지를 변형해 재전송하던 문제 추가 수정
items.en: Fixed more cases of continued or resumed sessions (`--continue`, `--resume`) re-sending earlier messages in a changed form, which could make the API drop Claude's earlier reasoning

items.ko: 작업 중 `/model` 등 즉시 실행 슬래시 명령을 쓰면 이전 확장 사고가 버려지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed earlier extended thinking being dropped when `/model`, `/rename`, `/artifacts` or another immediate slash command was used while Claude was working

items.ko: `--tools` 목록에서 기본 도구가 빠지면 재개한 대화의 확장 사고가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed continued or resumed conversations losing earlier extended thinking when relaunched with a `--tools` list that leaves out a built-in tool offered earlier in the conversation

items.ko: `redacted_thinking` 블록 오류로 매 턴 실패하던 문제 수정 — 사고 블록을 버리고 1회 재시도
items.en: Fixed sessions failing on every turn with an "Invalid `data` in `redacted_thinking` block" API error; Claude Code now drops the conversation's thinking blocks and retries once

items.ko: 요약 요청이 거부되어 컴팩션이 실패하던 문제 수정 — 폴백 모델로 재시도
items.en: Fixed compaction failing when the summarization request is refused; it now retries on a fallback model

items.ko: 사고 끄기 + high 초과 노력 세션에서 모델 전환 후 턴이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a failed turn ("Effort 'xhigh' isn't available with thinking turned off") after a safety-related model switch in sessions with thinking off and effort above high

items.ko: SDK 호스팅 세션에서 미응답 사용 크레딧 프롬프트가 모델을 바꾸던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed an unanswered Fable usage-credits prompt switching models in SDK-hosted sessions such as Claude Desktop; the turn now ends instead, and Remote Control clients now see the model-switch notice

items.ko: `/model`에 전체 Fable 모델 id 입력 시 크레딧 프롬프트 대신 API 오류가 나던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/model` with a full Fable model id stopping at an API error instead of opening the usage-credits prompt when the plan needs usage credits that aren't turned on yet

items.ko: 다른 프로세스가 종료된 뒤에도 로그인 갱신 오류로 최대 1분간 요청이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed requests failing for up to a minute with an "another Claude Code process is refreshing it" login error after that other process was closed or killed mid-refresh

items.ko: 다른 창이 로그인 갱신 중일 때 시작한 세션이 조직 정책을 재요청하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sessions started while another Claude Code window was refreshing the sign-in (common with several VS Code windows) not retrying their organization policy fetch

items.ko: 심볼릭 링크로 macOS `/Network` 등 외부 경로의 CLAUDE.md·규칙을 읽던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed CLAUDE.md and rules being read at startup through a repository symlink reaching macOS's `/Network` via `..` or a `/.vol`-style kernel path, or a rules link to macOS's `/home` being listed

items.ko: 설정 파일에서 중간에 `:*`가 있는 Bash 권한 규칙이 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash permission rules with a mid-pattern `:*` being skipped in settings files while `--allowedTools` honored them; they now work from every source, with a startup warning on how they match

items.ko: 복원된 권한 프롬프트에서 승인한 명령이 워커 재시작 시 두 번 실행되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a command approved on a restored permission prompt running twice when a remote session's worker restarted

items.ko: `disableClaudeAiConnectors` 등 잠금 키의 오타 값을 관리 설정이 무시하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed managed settings ignoring a mistyped value for boolean lock keys such as `disableClaudeAiConnectors` or `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; the lock now applies and startup names the key

items.ko: 중첩 값 하나가 잘못되면 관리 `permissions`·`autoMode` 블록 전체가 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed managed `permissions`, `autoMode`, `worktree` and `attribution` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the rest of the block now still applies

items.ko: `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`에서 스킬·명령이 `allowed-tools`로 자기 도구를 선승인하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed repository, user and `--add-dir` skills, commands and skills-directory plugin manifests pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`

items.ko: Bedrock 세이프가드 차단 메시지에 요청 ID·메시지 ID 표시
items.en: Fixed safeguard block messages on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock Mantle not showing a request ID; block messages now also show the message ID

items.ko: Vertex AI: 아직 인식하지 못하는 모델에 웹 검색이 제공되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Vertex AI: Fixed web search not being offered for models Claude Code doesn't recognize yet, such as newly released ones

items.ko: Bash·PowerShell이 디스크 할당량 초과를 `Exit code 1`로 가리던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash and PowerShell hiding a full disk quota behind "Exit code 1" and leaving large output files in temp

items.ko: 도구 입력 검증 오류가 잘못된 다른 매개변수도 함께 나열하도록 수정
items.en: Fixed tool input validation errors naming only an unknown, missing or mistyped parameter when other parameters in the same call were also invalid; those are now listed too

items.ko: 브래킷 붙여넣기 모드 초기화 후 여러 줄 붙여넣기가 줄 단위로 전송되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed pasted multi-line text being submitted line by line after the terminal's bracketed paste mode was reset mid-session

items.ko: `SessionStart` 훅이 있는 프로젝트에서 시작 시 예시 문구가 깜빡이던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the prompt's example text flashing and disappearing at startup in projects with a `SessionStart` hook

items.ko: 전체화면 모드로 시작할 때 첫 프레임 전에 빈 화면이 깜빡이던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a blank screen flashing before the first frame when starting in fullscreen mode

items.ko: 화면이 짧아진 뒤 비전체화면 렌더러의 줄이 깨지거나 어긋나던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed garbled, misplaced rows in the non-fullscreen renderer after the screen got shorter while still taller than the terminal, e.g. deleting a prompt line while a shell command streams output

items.ko: diff에서 CJK·이모지가 다음 줄로 넘어갈 때 마지막 열에 잔상이 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a stale character left in the last column of a diff when a redrawn line's CJK character or emoji wrapped to the next row

items.ko: 탭이 포함된 히스토리 프롬프트를 불러올 때 커서가 끝에 가지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the cursor landing before the end of a prompt recalled from history when the prompt contains a tab

items.ko: ctrl+enter를 개행으로 보내는 터미널에서 전송 힌트가 잘못 표시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the send-now hint showing ctrl+enter on terminals that send it as a newline (Windows Terminal before 1.25); it now shows ctrl+x ctrl+s there

items.ko: `claude remote-control --debug`가 인자 오류로 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude remote-control --debug` failing with "Unknown argument: --debug", although Remote Control's own eligibility error says to run with `--debug`

items.ko: `/install-github-app` 취소 후에도 브랜치 푸시와 API 키 저장이 진행되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` saying "cancelled" and then still pushing the branch and saving the API key secret; leaving now stops the remaining steps and reports what was already done

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex에서 `/feedback`·`/bug` 저장을 취소해도 파일이 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share on Bedrock, Vertex and other third-party providers still saving the report file after you cancelled during the save

items.ko: 설정이 아직 켜 둔 플러그인의 제거가 성공으로 보고되며 옵션을 지우던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugin uninstall reporting success and deleting the plugin's saved options when its settings file still enabled it or could not be read; it now stops and names the file

items.ko: 설치 목록을 읽지 못하면 플러그인 제거가 저장된 옵션·시크릿을 지우던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugin uninstall deleting a plugin's saved options and secrets when the list of installed plugins could not be read after the removal; they are now kept and the uninstall says so

items.ko: `/skills`에서 `/` 직후 입력한 키가 검색창 대신 목록을 움직이던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a key typed right after `/` in `/skills` moving the skill list instead of reaching the search box

items.ko: `/skills` 검색창에서 입력 중 커서가 목록으로 튀어 IME 입력이 어긋나던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the terminal cursor jumping from the `/skills` search box to the skill list while typing, which could hide the caret and put IME input in the wrong place

items.ko: 전체화면 밖에서 `/skills`·`/mcp` 목록이 두 칸 좁게 그려지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed lists with a scrollbar, such as `/skills` and `/mcp`, being two columns narrower outside fullscreen mode, where the scrollbar can never appear

items.ko: 긴 재지정 키로 에이전트 패널 푸터가 두 줄로 줄바꿈되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the agent panel footer wrapping onto two lines with long rebound keys, and its "Esc to collapse" hint ignoring a rebound collapse key

items.ko: 단축키가 해제된 경우 `/tasks` 푸터에 `·` 구분자가 중복되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a doubled `·` separator in the `/tasks` dialog footer when the stop-all-agents shortcut is unbound in `keybindings.json`

items.ko: 버전 라벨이 60자를 넘으면 아티팩트 게시가 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed artifact publishes failing when Claude gave the version a label longer than 60 characters; the label is now shortened

items.ko: 스크린리더 모드·인용 목록에서 코드 블록 위 빈 줄이 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed screen-reader mode, quoted lists and very long lists dropping the blank lines at the top of a code block that opens a list item, directly or inside a quote

items.ko: PDF 페이지 읽기 오류의 비라틴 경로 표시와 잘못된 원인 표기 수정
items.en: Fixed PDF page-read error messages: paths with accented or non-Latin characters now appear readably, and a folder named like "password" or "invalid" can no longer make the error name the wrong cause

items.ko: vim 모드 `>>`·`r`·`2J`와 마지막 줄 카운트 동작이 잘못되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode `>>` indenting empty lines, `r` with a count longer than the line changing text, `2J` joining one line too many, and a count on the last line (`2dd`, `2>>`) shifting or deleting it

items.ko: vim 모드 `dd`·`dj`·`p`·`yy` 이후 커서 위치가 잘못되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode cursor placement: after `dd`, `dj`, `dG` or a whole-line `p`/`P` it lands on the first non-blank, `yy` no longer moves it, and Esc after an emoji no longer leaves it inside the emoji

items.ko: vim 모드가 `.` 앞 카운트를 무시하고 줄바꿈된 줄에서 잘못 동작하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode ignoring a count typed before `.` when repeating `x`, `s`, `p`, `d` or `c`, and whole-line `p`/`P`, `o`, `O`, `J`, `>>` and `<<` acting on the wrong line when a line above wraps

items.ko: vim 모드에서 불러온 프롬프트의 커서가 줄 끝을 넘어가 `x`가 듣지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a prompt recalled from history or pulled back from the queue in normal mode, so `x` did nothing

items.ko: 아주 큰 세션의 재개 속도 개선
items.en: Improved the time to resume very large sessions, including ones that were never compacted

items.ko: Windows에서 트랜스크립트를 읽지 못해 재개가 실패할 때(EBADF) 오류 안내 개선
items.en: Improved the error shown on Windows when a session can't be resumed because its transcript file could not be read (EBADF): it now names possible causes and what to try

items.ko: Claude Desktop의 알 수 없는 모델 오류에 다른 모델 전환 안내 추가
items.en: Improved the Claude Desktop unknown-model error to suggest switching to a different model

items.ko: 권한 프롬프트의 특이 유니코드 렌더링 개선
items.en: Improved rendering of unusual Unicode in permission prompts

items.ko: `/artifacts` 목록 정렬·줄임 처리와 PgUp/PgDn·마우스 지원 개선
items.en: Improved `/artifacts`: titles line up in one column, details are dropped whole instead of cut mid-word, and the list supports PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, the mouse wheel and clicks

items.ko: `claude-api` 스킬의 거부 응답 과금·레이트 리밋 설명 갱신
items.en: Updated the `claude-api` skill: pre-output refusal billing now links to the How refusals are billed docs, mid-stream refusals bill at normal rates, and pre-output refusals count against rate limits

items.ko: `claude-api` 스킬에 Managed Agents 리소스 관리용 `ant apply` 권장 추가
items.en: Updated the `claude-api` skill to recommend `ant apply` for keeping Managed Agents resources as version-controlled files

items.ko: 텔레메트리가 꺼진 직접 API 연결에서 자동 모드가 서버 분류기를 기본 사용
items.en: Changed auto mode to use the server-side classifier by default on a direct Anthropic API connection when telemetry is off (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out)

items.ko: `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`일 때 프로젝트·로컬 `sandbox.excludedCommands` 무시
items.en: Changed `sandbox.excludedCommands` to ignore project and local settings entries when managed settings or `--settings` set `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`, or managed `allowManagedDomainsOnly: true`

items.ko: 프로젝트·로컬 설정이 내보내기 관련 OpenTelemetry 변수를 무시하도록 변경
items.en: Changed project and local settings to ignore OpenTelemetry variables that turn on export, set its endpoint, or capture content, like `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` and `OTEL_LOG_*`

items.ko: Windows/WSL에서 관리자 정책이 손상되면 사용자 쓰기 가능 설정도 적용되지 않도록 변경
items.en: Changed Windows/WSL managed settings so an admin policy that is present but invalid or unreadable (HKLM, `managed-settings.json`) keeps user-writable HKCU and WSL `/etc/claude-code` from applying

items.ko: `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` 허용 규칙이 claude.ai 동기화 스킬만 포함하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` allow rules to cover only skills synced from claude.ai, not plugins or other skills that merely use such a name

items.ko: `anthropic-skills`·`claude-ai` 이름의 스킬·명령 폴더가 더는 로드되지 않도록 변경
items.en: Changed skill folders, command files and workflow commands in the `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` namespace to no longer load; a plugin so named still loads but yields name ties to synced skills

items.ko: `anthropic-skills`·`claude-ai` 이름의 MCP 서버가 스킬·프롬프트를 표시하지 않도록 변경
items.en: Changed MCP servers configured under the name `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` to list no skills or prompts (their tools still work); rename the server in your MCP configuration to list them again

items.ko: `/effort`·입력창의 `ultracode` 연출을 기본 스타일로 변경
items.en: Changed the `ultracode` visuals in `/effort` and the prompt input to plain styling (no ripple, border flourish or keyword glimmer) and removed the dynamic-workflows spinner tip

items.ko: 시작 배너의 Clawd 마스코트 발 위치 변경
items.en: Changed the Clawd mascot's feet in the start-up banner to sit under the corners of his body

items.ko: [VSCode] 긴 답변의 스트리밍이 밀리던 문제 수정 — 전체 재파싱 제거
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed long replies falling behind the stream: the panel no longer re-parses the whole reply on every update

items.ko: [VSCode] 받아쓰기 마이크 버튼이 입력창 스크롤바를 가리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the dictation mic button covering the message input's scrollbar when the input is tall enough to scroll

items.ko: [VSCode] 이 컴퓨터에서 시작한 Remote Control 세션이 목록에서 열리지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Remote Control sessions started on this computer not opening from their Web entry in the session list; they now open the local conversation unless it's running elsewhere

items.ko: [VSCode] 확장 호스트 재시작 후 로그인 화면이 말없이 멈춰 있던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed an editor tab's sign-in screen hanging silently after the extension host restarts; it now shows the "stopped responding" notice too

items.ko: [Cloud sessions] 설정에 Claude GitHub App 설치·연결 상태와 연결 단계 추가
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Added Claude GitHub App status to Settings › Connectors › GitHub: whether the app is installed and reachable for your account, plus steps to connect, install or reconnect

items.ko: [Cloud sessions] GitHub 외 저장소 메뉴에 저장소·비교 페이지 링크 추가
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Added "Open repository" and "Open compare page" links to the repository menu of a cloud session whose repository is hosted on a Git server other than GitHub

items.ko: [Cloud sessions] 실행 중인 세션에 다른 소유자의 저장소를 추가로 연결 가능
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Added attaching a repository from a different GitHub owner, such as a fork's upstream, to a running cloud session that already has one, including sessions started from Slack

items.ko: [Cloud sessions] 30분 오프셋 시간대에서 시간별 루틴의 다음 실행 시각이 틀리던 문제 수정
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the next run time shown for an hourly routine being 30 minutes off for people in half-hour-offset time zones such as India

items.ko: [Cloud sessions] 루틴 페이지와 사이드바 예약 목록의 로딩 속도 개선
items.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved how quickly the Routines page and the sidebar's Scheduled list load for accounts whose past sessions scheduled many check-in reminders

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Enterprise Grid 조직 설치에서 자동 참여 채널 패턴이 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed auto-join channel patterns saved for one workspace in Claude Tag admin settings being ignored on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install; Claude now joins matching new channels

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 두 워크스페이스가 공유한 Grid 채널에서 응답하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude not responding in an Enterprise Grid channel shared between two workspaces of one organization when the channel's Claude Tag version was saved from the other workspace

items.ko: [Claude Tag] GitHub Enterprise Server 저장소 진행 카드의 저장소명·PR 버튼 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card for sessions on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository: it now names the repository and offers a working Create PR button

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 은퇴한 모델의 스레드가 매 응답마다 폴백하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads whose model has been retired falling back to another model on every reply, slower and with a fallback note each time; the thread now moves to a working model

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Slack 업로드 파일의 캡션에 표가 렌더링되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed files Claude uploads to Slack not being able to carry a caption containing a table; captions now render with the same formatting as replies

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Agents & tools 목록에 스레드가 이름 대신 첫 메시지로 표시되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's threads in Slack's Agents & tools view sometimes being listed under their first message instead of their name; later renames now update the list too

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 연결 해제된 GitHub 조직의 권한을 액세스 번들에서 제거해도 저장되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed removing a GitHub organization's grant from an access bundle's Repositories tab in Claude Tag admin settings failing to save after that GitHub organization was disconnected

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 앱이 추가되지 않은 Grid 워크스페이스 공유 채널의 안내 문구 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude always replying "Couldn't check this channel just now" in a channel shared with a Grid workspace it isn't added to; the notice now says which workspace needs the app

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 워커 재시작 후 응답 푸터의 비용·토큰 합계가 과도하게 높던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the cost and token totals in Claude's reply footer reading many times too high after the session's cloud worker restarted

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Slack 답변의 테두리 카드를 기본 넓은 폭으로 변경
items.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the bordered cards Claude uses in Slack replies for plans, tables and details to render wide by default instead of a narrow width

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 새로 연결된 워크스페이스가 현재 기본 모델을 따르도록 변경
items.en: [Claude Tag] Changed newly connected Slack workspaces to follow the current default model instead of keeping whichever model was the default when they were connected

items.ko: Claude apps 게이트웨이의 `desktop` 정책 키 지원 추가
items.en: Added Claude apps gateway support for newer Claude Desktop keys in `desktop` policy blocks, including `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` and `disableBypassPermissionsMode`

items.ko: 게이트웨이 Bedrock 업스트림에 `assume_role` 추가
items.en: Added `assume_role` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams: the gateway calls Bedrock as an IAM role it assumes through STS, in another AWS account if needed, optionally one session per developer

items.ko: 게이트웨이 Bedrock 업스트림에 `guardrail` 적용 추가
items.en: Added `guardrail: {id, version}` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams to apply an Amazon Bedrock guardrail to every request sent through them (set it on all Bedrock upstreams or none)

items.ko: 게이트웨이 설정에 `telemetry.resource_attributes` 추가
items.en: Added `telemetry.resource_attributes` to the Claude apps gateway config, to put fixed labels on the telemetry of Claude Desktop and `/login` sessions

items.ko: 커밋·PR 어트리뷰션을 숨기는 `"attribution": false` 추가
items.en: Added `"attribution": false` in `settings.json` to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions

items.ko: MCP URL 모드 elicitation 지원 추가
items.en: Added MCP URL-mode elicitation on 2026-07-28 protocol connections, so servers can ask Claude Code to open a browser-based flow; no waiting dialog is left on screen when the server has no way to confirm completion

items.ko: `claude plugin validate`에 MCP 서버 검사 추가
